title: 6.5 A Trip to the Mall
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Describe a short trip with a destination, boarding, travel, getting off, walking, an errand and a return.
grammar_function: Ana walks to the bus stop, gets on the bus, gets off at the mall, walks inside, requests and receives juice, thanks the clerk, then takes a taxi home and gets out.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Describe a short trip with a destination, boarding, travel, getting off, walking, an errand and a return.
